title: personas.yaml, the presets a module registry's installer offers
description: A store's personas.yaml, beside its modules.yaml (brain.presets, docs/modules.md « Presets and personas »): the presets of the registry, each a set of bricks, modules and distributions; a persona is a preset a platform's documents describe, written by an import session (source, imported) and never by hand. brain modules --check validates the file (exit 1); brain modules --personas runs the two checks on each preset: its set closed under the hard dependencies of the map, and a preset whose ai is false pulls no AI module nor a distribution that ships one. An unknown key, at the top or in a preset, is a newer brain's: a note in read mode, kept; an error in strict mode (CI). A higher v is refused in both modes, its other keys not judged.

source.description: The documents the import read, each its ref and its date (YYYY-MM-DD).

imported.description: The day of the import (YYYY-MM-DD): no source is dated after it.

ref.description: The document read, by a reference its reader understands (a title, a section).

section.description: The part of the document read.

expand.description: How a brick a preset lists becomes modules: every module of the registry with that brick, except those whose status or placement is listed here.

skip_status.description: The registry statuses a brick does not give (default: [proposed]).

skip_placement.description: The registry placements a brick does not give (the platform's own words: a module set aside); default none.

id.description: The preset's id, unique in the file.

name.description: Its name, as the documents give it.

kind.description: persona (the default): described by the documents, imported; preset: written by hand.

audience.description: Who it is for, as the documents say.

bricks.description: The bricks it takes: each gives its modules (expand).

modules.description: The modules it takes alone, ids of the registry.

optional.description: What it may add: checked as a second variant of the preset (its set with them).

distributions.description: The distributions it downloads, as the map's ships_in names them.

ai.description: Whether it uses AI: false asks that it pull no AI module (ai: true in the map) and no distribution that ships one; absent, the documents do not say and the check does not run.

topology.description: Where it runs, as the documents say.

realm.description: The realms it spans, as the documents name them.

description.description: What the documents say of its configuration.

note.description: What the import read into the documents' words (a range, a part of a module).
